name: Ursoi
pages: pp. 217–221, Ursoi racial traits and racial class table
evidence: Viewer pages 218–222. The stat block takes scent range from the table. The scent paragraph contains an inconsistent reference to 7th level alongside the 4th-level unlock. The table grants 10 ft. at level 4 and 20 ft. at level 6, with no further range increase at level 7.

name: Draconian
pages: pp. 33–37, Baaz and Kapak Racial Traits, and p. 217 for the Baaz CR benchmark
evidence: Viewer pages 34–38 and 218. One profile covers the two playable options from Chapter 1. Bress uses the Baaz option and the 3.5 fighter class. His CR is an estimate based on the printed Baaz benchmark.
